veranderings.voor: Toe draai hy dit op na die hemel.
veranderings.na: Toe rig hy dit op die hemel.
veranderings.rede: 'Draai op na' is not idiomatic for pointing an instrument; 'rig op' is the natural Afrikaans.

veranderings.blok: Wat hy in die hemel gesien het
veranderings.voor: Venus het ook fases net soos ons eie maan.
veranderings.na: Venus het ook fases, net soos ons eie maan.
veranderings.rede: A comma before the comparison makes the sentence easier to read aloud and separates it from the next sentence's 'net soos'.

veranderings.blok: Wat hy in die hemel gesien het
veranderings.rede: The nearest noun is 'ons eie maan', so 'dit' could be read as the Moon; naming Venus removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.voor: Hier was dinge wat jy self kon sien draai om iets anders as die Aarde.
veranderings.na: Hier was dinge wat jy self om iets anders as die Aarde kon sien draai.
veranderings.rede: In a subordinate clause the prepositional phrase belongs before the verb cluster; the current order is wooden.

veranderings.na: het dit al voor hom voorgestel
veranderings.rede: 'Voor hom voorgestel' can be misread as 'proposed it to him'; 'al' makes the time sense of 'voor' clear without adding content.

veranderings.blok: Die botsing en wat gebly het
veranderings.voor: Hy is verhoor en hy moes sê
veranderings.na: Hy is verhoor, en hy moes sê
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' joining two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Die botsing en wat gebly het
veranderings.rede: The fixed expression is 'in die tronk sit'.

veranderings.voor: 'n Buis met glase wat ver dinge
veranderings.na: 'n Buis met lense wat ver dinge
veranderings.rede: 'Glase' can be read as drinking glasses; 'lense' is the precise word for the glass parts of a telescope and is known at Grade 6.
'Op 'n keer' is vague and awkward here; 'op 'n bepaalde tyd' says clearly that the shape depends on when you look.

vlae.teks: Hy het later as Leonardo da Vinci gelewe en is eers ná Leonardo se dood gebore.
vlae.rede: The two halves say the same thing twice; tightening it would mean cutting a clause, which is the writer's call, not a language change.

vlae.teks: Hy het die teleskoop dus nie self uitgevind nie.
vlae.rede: The block calls the instrument 'kykglas' throughout and then switches to 'teleskoop' without linking the two words; a learner may not see they are the same thing. Linking them is a content decision for the writer.
